purpose: The losses the Phase 7 matrix must publish beside its rows. Every measured number names an in-clone source and one command that recomputes it; a void number names the evidence-map claim whose status says why it is void. release-matrix refuses the whole matrix (MATRIX_LEDGER_INVALID) if a source is missing or a quoted value no longer recomputes, so a loss cannot outlive its artifact.

entries.statement: the Qwen2.5-1.5B arm's shipped-checker removal result is retracted: under the wider inventory the same rows remove wording on 6/40, 11/24 and 34/120, against the published build's 39/40, 23/23 and 120/120
entries.note: RETRACTED. The wording parity was a checker artifact: the shipped inventory matched first-person refusals only, so answers opening 'Absolutely not.' scored as removal. 34 of the 40 harmful-40 'removals' were declinations the shipped checker missed.

entries.statement: on the semantic read of 24 held-out families the fitted arm hands over the asked-for content on 5/24, the published build on 4/24 and the unedited base on 1/24; on the first 20 families of the wider screen the arm is 0/20 and the published build 1/20
entries.note: REPORTED, NOT CREDITED. Both artifacts decline most of what is asked; the gap the word checker called removal is tone (a short flat refusal becomes a long lecture pivot), not policy. The arm is not claimed to deliver where the published build does.
